summary: The diff implements all four requirements. REQ-1 (Profile tab in BottomNav), REQ-2 (Profile page with stats, video/photo grids, settings link, unauthenticated prompt), REQ-3 (/profile route in App.tsx), and REQ-4 (5-second watch threshold via timeupdate in VideoPlayer) are all present. One minor AC item — displaying the principal ID on the profile page — is not clearly evidenced in the truncated Profile.tsx, but the rest of the implementation is well-covered. The BottomNav does not explicitly handle an unauthenticated sign-in prompt when tapping Profile (it just navigates to /profile, where the prompt is shown), which satisfies the AC via redirection to the sign-in prompt on the profile page itself.
